title: Thousands of us…
content: Last night, for the first time, there were thousands of us at MW. It was like the dorm resort “move in” was complete, and now everyone was looking for places to eat and things to do, things were bustling and busy. Normally it’s pretty bare, people-wise, but the “people in charge” looked more like tall gray aliens with clipboards. So here’s where things get weird. I have not had family members or my child in my MW dreams before, but this week, my mother (who is my mother irl) is in the “Florida” area of MW, where my aunt and uncle “live” in a weird apartment complex (but they’re yre never there), with a bunch of two-story units. The weird part? She’s actually down in FL visiting (irl) but in my dream, she’s also there. Now, this could simply be my subconscious, but last night’s dream involved me having my toddler with me in MW, which hasn’t happened before. Has something changed in your MW? Mine is suddenly flooded with people, and buzzing with excitement (that almost feels frightening). Anybody else? Just me?
